paused.label: Paused
paused.blurb: A dead stop at the bottom — no stretch reflex, so the same load buys fewer reps.

tempo.label: Tempo
tempo.blurb: A slow, controlled lowering (3–4 s down) — more time under tension per rep.

deficit.label: Deficit
deficit.blurb: From a plate or block — a longer range of motion and a harder start.

drop.label: Drop set
drop.blurb: Straight into a lighter weight with no rest — a continuation of the set before it.

rest-pause.label: Rest-pause
rest-pause.blurb: A short breath (10–20 s) and more reps at the same weight.

partials.label: Partials
partials.blurb: Reps through part of the range, usually once full reps run out.
